description: The Statens vegvesen data portal is a CKAN catalogue that lists 87 datasets from the Norwegian Public Roads Administration, all under the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD). It includes bridges and tunnels, landslide and avalanche events with road closures, DATEX II traffic information, the ferry database, the TRINE accident register, travel times, road weather data, webcam images, TN-ITS road attribute updates and strategic noise maps, together with the NVDB road database and traffic counts. The agency's open data page also describes DATEX II weather, travel time, webcam and traffic information services and the Norwegian TMC location table. Coverage is Norway. Access: free, with each dataset linking to its API or download, and the catalogue itself has a CKAN API. Caveats: datasets differ in format, update rhythm and documentation, much of it only in Norwegian. It supports road network hazard exposure (landslides, avalanches), disruption and closure analysis, ferry link modelling and real-time digital twins, and complements the NVDB and Trafikkdata records catalogued here.
